register_component_in_container: register a component with a factory function into a dependency container by name and config class
create_component_via_manager: create a component instance by resolving its registered factory and passing structured config
structure_component_config_from_dict: structure an unstructured config dict into the registered component config class using a value converter
define_component_factory_protocol: define a callable protocol that takes a dependency resolver and config to produce a component instance
handle_component_not_known_error: handle the ComponentNotKnownError exception when a component name is not registered for a given class
